description: This file defines a configuration class for managing calculated fields in the Thingsboard UI, including methods for CRUD operations, debugging, importing/exporting, and dialog interactions.

classes.name: CalculatedFieldsTableConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for managing calculated fields table, including CRUD, debugging, import/export, and dialog interactions.

methods.name: fetchCalculatedFields
methods.description: Fetches calculated fields with pagination, depending on page mode.

methods.name: onOpenDebugConfig
methods.description: Opens debug configuration panel for a calculated field.

methods.name: openDebugTab
methods.description: Opens the debug tab for a calculated field in the UI.

methods.name: editCalculatedField
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit a calculated field.

methods.name: getCalculatedFieldDialog
methods.description: Opens dialog for creating or editing a calculated field.

methods.name: openDebugEventsDialog
methods.description: Opens dialog to view debug events for a calculated field.

methods.name: exportCalculatedField
methods.description: Exports a calculated field to a file.

methods.name: copyCalculatedField
methods.description: Creates a copy of a calculated field.

methods.name: importCalculatedField
methods.description: Imports a calculated field from a file.

methods.name: updateImportedCalculatedField
methods.description: Adjusts imported calculated field data for tenant-specific references.

methods.name: onDebugConfigChanged
methods.description: Updates debug settings for a calculated field.

methods.name: getTestScriptDialog
methods.description: Opens dialog to test calculated field scripts.

methods.name: openCalculatedField
methods.description: Navigates to the calculated field detail page.

methods.name: onCFAction
methods.description: Handles actions on calculated field entities, such as open or export.
